title: 第七章实力
novel_title: 扫地八十年，从宗门杂役飞升成仙
content_zh:
门外，两个杂役正准备推门。

    叶凡直接拉开门。

    砰的一声，木门大开。

    门外两人吓了一跳，连退两步。

    “谁！”

    叶凡站在门口，活动了一下脖颈，骨头发出脆响。

    “两位，大清早的，找我？”

    两人看清面前的人，愣在原地。

    这人穿着叶凡的杂役服，但脸庞年轻，气血旺盛，完全不是那个满脸老年斑的快死老头。

    “你……你是谁？叶凡那老东西呢？”高个子脱口而出。

    叶凡拍了拍衣服上的灰尘。

    “怎么，换了身皮，就不认识了？”

    两人对视一眼，满脸不可思议。

    “你是叶凡？不可能！那老东西半截身子都入土了，你怎么可能……”矮个子话说到一半，突然顿住。

    他上下打量着叶凡，突然大笑起来。

    “哈哈哈哈！我还以为你得了什么天大的机缘，原来是回光返照！”

    高个子也反应过来，感受了一下叶凡身上的灵气波动。

    “锻体一阶！这老东西连修为都散了，现在就是个废人！”

    两人都是锻体六阶，在废阁也算是一霸。

    原本还担心叶凡有什么底牌，现在彻底放下心来。

    “马管事还让我们小心点，真是白瞎了。”高个子捏着拳头，指关节咔咔作响。

    “老东西，不管你用了什么邪术变年轻，今天都得死！”

    矮个子抽出短刀扑了上来。

    “跟他废什么话，宰了回去领赏！”

    叶凡站在原地没动。

    他看着两人冲过来，脑子里飞速计算着双方的距离和速度。

    太慢了。

    在现在的叶凡眼里，这两个锻体六阶的动作，简直慢得离谱。

    矮个子手里的短刀，直奔叶凡心窝。

    躲？叶凡根本没打算躲，抬起右手屈指一弹。

    铛！

    手指弹在刀刃上。

    一股巨力顺着刀身传导过去。

    矮个子只觉得虎口一麻，短刀脱手飞出，在空中转了几个圈，插进远处的泥地里。

    “什么！”矮个子吓傻了。

    还没等他反应过来，叶凡的拳头已经到了。

    叶凡收着劲儿，三分力一拳砸在矮个子胸口。

    砰！

    矮个子整个人倒飞出去，重重砸在木墙上，张嘴喷出一大口鲜血。

    高个子见状，脸都绿了。

    “你隐藏了修为！”

    他怒吼一声，浑身灵气爆发，双拳砸向叶凡面门。

    叶凡这回连手都没抬，直接挺起胸膛迎了上去。

    轰！

    高个子的双拳结结实实打在叶凡胸口。

    叶凡纹丝不动。

    高个子却惨叫一声，双手手腕同时折断，骨茬刺破皮肤露了出来。

    “啊——我的手！”

    叶凡低头看了看自己的胸口，连个红印子都没留下。

    “九龙搬血，果然霸道。”

    锻体一阶的灵气，却有着锻体九阶巅峰的肉身强度。

    这副身体硬得离谱。

    叶凡懒得再跟他们废话，一步跨到高个子面前，伸手掐住他的脖子单手提了起来。

    “马得水让你们来的？”
content_en:
Outside the door, two handymen were preparing to push the door open.

    Ye Fan opened the door directly.

    With a bang, the wooden door opened wide.

    The two people outside the door were startled and took two steps back.

    "Who!"

    Ye Fan stood at the door, moved his neck, and his bones made a crisp sound.

    "You two, are you looking for me so early in the morning?"

    The two of them saw the person in front of them clearly and froze on the spot.

    This man was wearing Ye Fan's uniform, but he had a young face and strong vitality. He was not at all the dying old man with age spots on his face.

    "You...who are you? Where is that old guy Ye Fan?" the tall man blurted out.

    Ye Fan patted the dust on his clothes.

    "Why, you changed your body and you don't recognize me anymore?"

    The two looked at each other with disbelief on their faces.

    "Are you Mark? Impossible! Half of the old guy's body is buried in the ground, how could you..." The short man suddenly paused in the middle of his words.

    He looked at Ye Fan up and down and suddenly laughed.

    "Hahahaha! I thought you had some great opportunity, but it turned out to be a flashback!"

    The tall man also reacted and felt the spiritual energy fluctuations on Mark's body.

    "First level of body training! This old guy has even lost his cultivation and is now a useless person!"

    Both of them are at the sixth level of body training and can be regarded as the best in Feige.

    I was originally worried about what cards Ye Fan had, but now I am completely relieved.

    "Steward Ma told us to be careful, it's all in vain." The tall man clenched his fists and cracked his knuckles.

    "Old man, no matter what magic you use to become younger, you will die today!"

    The short man drew out his short knife and rushed forward.

    "What nonsense are you talking to him about? Kill him and go back to collect the reward!"

    Ye Fan stood still and didn't move.

    He watched the two men rushing over, and his mind quickly calculated the distance and speed of the two parties.

    Too slow.

    In the eyes of Ye Fan now, these two movements of the sixth level of body training are simply ridiculously slow.

    The short knife in the short man's hand went straight to Ye Fan's heart.

    hide? Ye Fan had no intention of hiding at all, he raised his right hand and flicked his fingers.

    clang!

    Fingers flicked on the blade.

    A huge force was transmitted along the blade.

    The short man only felt that the tiger's mouth was numb, and the short knife flew out of his hand, spun several times in the air, and was inserted into the mud in the distance.

    "What!" The short man was frightened.

    Before he could react, Mark's fist had already arrived.

    Ye Fan held back his strength and punched the short man in the chest with three points of force.

    Bang!

    The short man flew backwards, hit the wooden wall hard, opened his mouth and spurted out a large mouthful of blood.

    When the tall man saw this, his face turned green.

    "You hid your cultivation!"

    He roared angrily, his spiritual energy burst out, and he smashed his fists into Ye Fan's face.

    Mark didn't even raise his hand this time, he straightened up his chest and faced him.

    boom!

    The tall man's fists hit Ye Fan firmly on the chest.

    Ye Fan remained motionless.

    The tall man screamed, his wrists were broken at the same time, and the bone stubble pierced the skin and was exposed.

    "Ah—my hand!"

    Ye Fan lowered his head and looked at his chest, not even a red mark was left.

    "Jiulong is so domineering."

    The spiritual energy of the first level of body training has the physical strength of the peak of the ninth level of body training.

    This body is ridiculously hard.

    Ye Fan was too lazy to talk nonsense to them anymore. He stepped in front of the tall man, reached out and grabbed his neck and lifted him up with one hand.

    "Did Ma Deshui ask you to come?"
